investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Mermark Studios (online gaming); Platform: Google Cloud us-central1 (zones us-central1-a/us-central1-b/us-central1-c/us-central1-f); network range 10.202.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster mermar-prod-uscent (GKE); Edge: two nginx load balancers (lb-01, lb-02) behind DNS round-robin terminate client connections for game-gateway; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
